description: Publisher product search and reported retail/sale price fields through the Rakuten Advertising Product Search API. No account setup, advertiser application, affiliate-link creation or transaction write is included.

capabilities.title: Supply a Rakuten publisher API access token to the HTTP client
capabilities.blocker: No publisher token was supplied. The client accepts one in process memory but does not create an account/application or retrieve credentials.

capabilities.title: Search advertiser products and return validated product price fields
capabilities.blocker: Only a single anonymous no-token control request was made; it returned HTTP 401 JSON. No authenticated publisher catalog request was possible without a publisher token.

capabilities.title: Keep retail price, listed sale price and currency separate; avoid inventing stock
capabilities.blocker: Field normalization has local fixtures only. Live currency/price values and advertiser feed freshness are unverified; stock and sale-active dates are not returned by the documented Product Search response.

capabilities.title: Page through at most 1000 products while preserving reported totals and truncation
capabilities.blocker: The API reference states 1000 results per query while the Publisher Help article states 5000. The implementation caps collection at the lower bound and never marks a larger query exhausted.

capabilities.title: Preserve the returned publisher product/tracking URL without constructing new links
capabilities.blocker: The documented linkurl field is normalized as affiliateURL and kept separate from a canonical merchant URL. It has only local fixture evidence.

capabilities.title: Search a Sephora advertiser MID after the publisher confirms its applicable partnership
capabilities.blocker: Sephora US identifies Rakuten Advertising for its affiliate program, but the current publisher's partnership and advertiser MID are unknown. No MID is guessed and no application is submitted.

capabilities.title: Verify commission terms from current advertiser offers
capabilities.blocker: Product Search does not return commission rates. No generic Sephora percentage is asserted; current publisher-specific offer terms require an approved advertiser relationship and another documented operation.
